main.description: Annual stewardship attestation by the Lv5 護 Steward. Boundary check, condition assessment, biodiversity census reference. Per ADR-2605192245 §5.1. Required annually.

boundaryVerified.description: Steward physically inspected boundary; matches geojsonCid.

boundaryDeltaCid.description: IPFS CID of optional boundary delta document if encroachment / shift observed.

biodiversityRecordUri.description: AT URI of the linked land-biodiversity record for this year.

accessProvided.description: Steward provided reasonable access to etzhayyim adherents for religious gathering / meditation during the year.

commercialExtractionAbsent.description: No commercial extraction (mining / clear-cut / large-scale monoculture) occurred. Required true per ADR-2605192245 §5.1.

nationalObligationsCurrent.description: Property tax / national obligations paid in full (dual-recognition responsibility).
